body: On macOS (platform === 'darwin'), agy 1.5.17 reads OAuth credentials from $HOME/Library/Keychains. When stageIsolatedGeminiHome() redirects HOME to .agb_home, missing Library/Keychains causes silent auth to fail and time out after 60s. Symlink only userHome/Library/Keychains into agbHome/Library/Keychains on darwin, add regression test in test/agy-no-mcp-storm.test.mjs, and rebuild dist/**.
title: Stage macOS Library/Keychains in isolated agb homes for agy 1.5.17 auth
